owner_package_metadata.title: Guardian Alpha V30 Stage 2H-A - Owner Decision & Governance Package

executive_notice: No automated agent has authorization to execute market trades, purchase subscriptions, connect to external APIs, or sign tokens. The following 6 decisions are explicitly reserved for the human repository owner.

decisions.title: Select and Authorize Prospective Market-Data Feed Provider
decisions.explanation: To conduct forward-looking paper evaluation, the system requires clean, daily EOD bars for the 24-ticker universe without accessing sealed historical Tier 3 data.
available_supported_options: Option A: Tiingo Market Data API (Power/Developer Tier, ~$10-$30/mo)
Option C: Alpaca Markets Paper Brokerage API ($0/mo, delayed/IEX data)
Option D: Interactive Brokers Client Portal API ($0/mo paper account with live funded account)
decisions.recommended_default: Option A (Tiingo EOD Personal API). Justification: Highest reliability for simple daily batch EOD REST queries, native split/dividend adjustment fields, and explicit terms authorizing private quantitative modeling.
decisions.consequences: Selected provider dictates API client configuration, rate limit handling, and daily ingestion batch timing.
decisions.reversibility: REVERSIBLE at any time prior to session commitment.
decisions.missing_evidence: Valid subscriber API key; owner must contract directly with vendor.
decisions.exact_action_required_from_owner: Sign up for preferred vendor, copy API key to untracked local .env file (NEVER commit to Git).

decisions.title: Verify Applicable Data License and Local Storage Rights
decisions.explanation: Legal confirmation that subscriber's chosen plan permits storing raw bars on local disk and computing proprietary weight allocations.
available_supported_options: Option A: Confirm personal/developer private non-commercial modeling terms
Option B: Request institutional commercial redistribution addendum (only if publishing public website/SaaS)
decisions.recommended_default: Option A. Guardian Alpha is an internal private research repository; developer terms are fully sufficient.
decisions.consequences: Avoids over-paying for enterprise redistribution rights while ensuring complete copyright compliance.
decisions.missing_evidence: Owner's personal review and acceptance of vendor Terms of Service.
decisions.exact_action_required_from_owner: Review vendor ToS section on 'Internal Business/Personal Use' and approve.

decisions.title: Approve Prospective Primary Endpoint and Non-Inferiority Margin
decisions.explanation: Defines the exact mathematical criterion for testing whether Candidate D2 (50% defensive cash cushion) beats Frozen E0.
available_supported_options: Option A: Paired Defensive Shortfall Reduction theta_def > 0 with CAGR non-inferiority margin delta_tol = 2.0% / year
Option B: Strict CAGR equality delta_tol = 0.0% (Risk: excessive conservatism, rejects D2 even if drawdown improves massively)
Option C: Wider non-inferiority margin delta_tol = 4.0% / year
decisions.recommended_default: Option A (2.0% CAGR non-inferiority margin). Justification: Reflects realistic cash drag during persistent bull regimes while demanding meaningful downside shortfall protection in stress regimes.
decisions.consequences: Binds statistical hypothesis testing for the entire prospective window.
decisions.reversibility: IRREVERSIBLE once forward evaluation begins (prevents p-hacking).
decisions.exact_action_required_from_owner: Approve or modify the 2.0% non-inferiority tolerance margin.

decisions.title: Approve Minimum Observation Horizon, Defensive Samples, and Stopping Rules
decisions.explanation: Specifies sample size adequacy to prevent declaring victory on calm bull market data.
available_supported_options: Option A: 252 sessions (1 year) with minimum 30 defensive sessions; halt at 20% drawdown
Option B: 126 sessions (6 months) with minimum 15 defensive sessions; halt at 25% drawdown
Option C: Indefinite evaluation until at least 50 defensive sessions occur
decisions.recommended_default: Option A (252 sessions, min 30 defensive sessions, 20% drawdown circuit breaker).
decisions.consequences: Guarantees statistical power; if fewer than 30 defensive sessions occur, trial is declared INCONCLUSIVE.

decisions.title: Approve Operational Observability and Incident Response Procedures
decisions.explanation: Adopts the 10 incident response playbooks for data outages, corrupt bars, hash mismatches, and risk limit breaches.
available_supported_options: Option A: Adopt proposed 10 fail-closed playbooks (INC-01 through INC-10)
Option B: Modify specific recovery actions
decisions.recommended_default: Option A. Enforces fail-closed safety on all critical invariants.
decisions.consequences: System will automatically pause or abort if any balance sheet drift or hash mutation occurs.

decisions.title: Approve Explicit Paper-Only Activation Token
decisions.explanation: Generation of a cryptographically signed JSON authorization token permitting ActivationGatekeeper to enter OWNER_AUTHORIZED_PAPER mode.
available_supported_options: Option A: Sign token targeting commit b283ded200c777b130285b0aa56a0b044afbd339
Option B: Leave activation BLOCKED until further notice
decisions.recommended_default: Option B (Leave BLOCKED until Decisions DEC-01 through DEC-05 are formally resolved).
decisions.reversibility: REVERSIBLE (Token can be revoked at any time).
decisions.exact_action_required_from_owner: Execute signing utility only when ready to initiate forward paper pilot.
